title: Identity-Locked Brand Portrait System
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait series for Actor Casting Portrait Sheet, built from one reference portrait and eight dependent variations.
creative_direction: Portrait backlog lock: image 01 establishes the exact person for Actor Casting Portrait Sheet; images 02-09 all depend on that reference and may vary only lighting, scene, wardrobe, pose, emotion, or grooming while preserving the same face, hair base, and body proportions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-portrait-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-clean-headshot, 03-three-quarter-hero, 04-profile-study, 05-approachable-smile, 06-dark-backdrop-editorial, 07-banner-crop-portrait, 08-monochrome-alt, 09-approval-sheet-layout. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
